{{Top|leg}}
A '''medical computer scomp link''' was a specialized [[Scomp link/Legends|scomp link]] used by [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]]. It allowed [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as the [[FX-series medical assistant droid/Legends|FX-series medical assistant droid]] to interface with a [[Medical diagnostic computer|medical computer]] or [[Medical droid/Legends|surgeon droid]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
